commands.move_tooltip: Move a unit towards a position or follow other units
commands.attack_tooltip: Attack a unit or ground position
commands.areaattack_tooltip: Area attack everything within a circle (click-drag)
commands.hero_battery_tooltip: A volley of homing rockets at the most valuable enemies around
commands.hero_doomsday_tooltip: Launches tactical nukes onto an area
commands.hero_blastshield_tooltip: A shield plate absorbs the damage the hero takes
commands.hero_orbital_tooltip: Calls heavy plasma shells from orbit onto an area
commands.hero_pulse_tooltip: Dumps half of the shield charge as an EMP shockwave that stuns everything around
commands.hero_dome_tooltip: Allies under the dome cannot be damaged for a few seconds
commands.hero_storm_tooltip: A lightning storm over an area; rank 3 ends in an EMP blast
commands.hero_stomp_tooltip: Slams the ground: damages and stuns everything around
commands.hero_siege_tooltip: Anchors in place: hardened armor, fast repair, a stronger shield
commands.hero_citadel_tooltip: Raises an armor dome: every ally inside takes far less damage
commands.hero_swarm_tooltip: Homing rockets at the most valuable enemies around
commands.hero_armageddon_tooltip: Designates an area: after a warning, a rain of rockets falls on it, sealed with a tactical nuke
commands.hero_hellcharge_tooltip: Dashes through the line, burning and knocking aside what it passes, and leaves a wall of fire
commands.hero_rainfire_tooltip: Meteors fall on an area; rank 3 ends in a fireball
commands.hero_flare_tooltip: A blinding burst: burns enemies around and repairs allies
commands.hero_sunstrike_tooltip: A column of sunlight burns an area for 6 s, creeping after the hottest enemy, and collapses: every heated enemy around ignites
commands.hero_meteorstorm_tooltip: Calls plasma meteors from orbit onto an area far away; rank 3 ends with a nuke
commands.hero_phase_tooltip: Fades from sight and moves faster for a few seconds
commands.hero_spear_tooltip: A 1.5 s charge, then one rail through the target and on along a line, through shields and terrain; the line burns for 5 s
commands.hero_mirror_tooltip: Storm images of the hero's mech fight at its side for a while
commands.hero_bladestorm_tooltip: Spins into a storm of blades: shreds everything around, takes half damage
commands.hero_autocast_tooltip: Hero abilities cast themselves when useful
commands.hero_empmissile_tooltip: A heavy EMP missile: damages and paralyses everything in the blast, heroes too
commands.hero_devour_tooltip: Consumes one of its own units with an electric strike and heals from it
commands.hero_rage_tooltip: Grows, wrapped in red lightning: faster, harder hitting, an electric orb strikes at twice the range
commands.hero_altar_upgrade_tooltip: Opens one more hero slot: 100k metal + 1M energy, then 200k + 2M; 45 s of research, the altar does not build meanwhile
commands.manuallaunch_tooltip: Launch a missile at a target
commands.patrol_tooltip: Patrol along one or more waypoints
commands.fight_tooltip: Order units to take action while moving to a position
commands.resurrect_tooltip: Revive wrecks to become units again (click-drag for area)
commands.guard_tooltip: Guard another unit against enemy units attacking it
commands.factoryguard_tooltip: Builders produced by this factory will automatically guard it
commands.wait_tooltip: Pause a unit/factory on processing command/build queues
commands.reclaim_tooltip: Suck metal/energy from wrecks or features (trees/stones)
commands.restore_tooltip: Restore an area of the map to its original height
commands.capture_tooltip: Convert units that belong to the enemy (or ally)
commands.settarget_tooltip: Set a prioritized target (prioritizes targeting when target in range)
commands.areamex_tooltip: Click-drag an area to auto queue metal extractors for all available metal spots
commands.loadunits_tooltip: Load unit or multiple units within an area in the transport
commands.unloadunits_tooltip: Unload unit or multiple units within an area in the transport
commands.stopproduction_tooltip: Clear build queue and quotas for all units on selected factories
commands.morph_tooltip: Upgrade to next Tech-level (second click to cancel)
commands.sellunit_tooltip: Toggle currently selected units for sale, allies will be able to buy them
commands.firestate_defend_descr: Fire upon enemies when they individually become a threat
commands.firestate_fire_at_all_descr: Fire upon anything belonging to the enemy within range
commands.firestate_tooltip: Set under what conditions a unit should start firing at enemies (without explicit attack order).
commands.movestate_tooltip: Set how far out of its way a unit should move to attack enemies
commands.bomber_targeting_tooltip: Hold Fire: Only attack with an explicit order. Fire at will: Idle bombers will seek targets within range.
commands.priority_tooltip: Assigns resources to use for this builder when not having enough for all
commands.onoff_tooltip: Active state: turn a unit on/off
commands.idlemode_tooltip: Sets what aircraft do when idle
commands.aplandat_tooltip: Sets what aircraft do when leaving air factory
commands.csspawning_tooltip: Sets the spawning state of the carrier
commands.trajectory_toggle_tooltip: Switch artillery firing angle between low, high and automatic trajectory
commands.hound_weapon_toggle_tooltip: Sets weapon to a slow plasma projectile with a large aoe, or a fast projectile gauss weapon
commands.blueprint_create_tooltip: Save the selected units into a new blueprint, in the order they were selected
commands.factoryqueuemode_tooltip:
Queue: Build each queued unit once
Quota: Maintain a minimum quota of each unit on the battlefield

customOnOff.trajectory_tooltip: Switch artillery firing angle between low and high trajectory
customOnOff.gauss_tooltip: Switches between Gauss Cannon and Heavy Plasma Cannon

commands.hero_thor_empmissile_tooltip: A heavy EMP missile: damages and paralyses everything in the blast, heroes too (half as long)
commands.hero_thor_devour_tooltip: Pulls in one of its own non-hero units with lightning and eats it: heals a share of the unit's health; healing past full charges the Thunder Coil (Static Overcharge)
commands.hero_thor_rage_tooltip: Thor grows, wrapped in red lightning: faster, quicker turret, tougher; a storm orb above it strikes with the Coil's damage at twice its range
commands.hero_atlas_bulwark_tooltip: Plants its feet: immobile, much tougher, taunts every enemy around and lashes attackers with lightning
commands.hero_atlas_salvo_tooltip: Empties the shoulder racks: guided rockets rain on the area, every hit Sunders its target, the last three rockets slow
commands.hero_atlas_lance_tooltip: The Doom Laser becomes a continuous lance twice its range long and sweeps a 60 degree arc
commands.hero_peewee_jump_tooltip: Leaps onto a point: the landing blasts and throws units back, then the guns run hot
commands.hero_peewee_bullethell_tooltip: Spins and sprays plasma in every direction at half speed: every enemy in gun range is hit (15 at most)
commands.hero_peewee_overrun_tooltip: Peewee and the army around charge: faster, harder hitting, Peewee unstoppable; kills extend it
commands.hero_razor_cloak_tooltip: Cloaks and speeds up; the first salvo out of the cloak is an Ambush. Enemies within 100 reveal it
commands.hero_razor_overcharge_tooltip: Toggle: the lasers fire much faster, burning the hull a little; switches itself off at 25% health (toggle)
commands.hero_prowler_harpoon_tooltip: A cable harpoon: damage, full Breach, drags the prey in (not heroes or heavier units) and roots it
commands.hero_prowler_fog_tooltip: A sea-fog cloud: allies inside are cloaked, enemies slowed, Prowler moves faster in it
commands.hero_prowler_apex_tooltip: Marks one prey: revealed, Prowler runs it down and hits it harder; missiles detonate Breach without using it. A kill heals 25% and refunds half the cooldown
commands.hero_ratte_barrage_tooltip: A walking wall of shells from 400 in front of the point to 400 behind it
commands.hero_ratte_maingun_tooltip: One shell from the landship's main gun: a huge blast (buildings x1.5) and a firestorm
commands.hero_recluse_webfield_tooltip: A web canister bursts into a field: enemies inside are slowed 50% and revealed; rockets blast wider there
commands.hero_recluse_cocoon_tooltip: Wraps an enemy (not a hero) in silk: stunned and taking +50% damage; if it dies, spiderlings hatch. Heroes are only rooted
commands.hero_recluse_monsoon_tooltip: Plants itself and rains rockets on an area; every rocket webs
commands.hero_olympus_flare_tooltip: A flare lights up an area deep in the fog for the whole team; Olympus' shells landing in it hit harder
commands.hero_olympus_anchor_tooltip: Toggle: digs in (1.5 s): immobile, longer range, more damage, tougher (toggle)
commands.hero_olympus_ionlance_tooltip: Calls an orbital ion lance: 3 s warning, then a blast that stuns, and three aftershocks
commands.hero_starlight_prism_tooltip: Links to an ally: every shot also refracts from it to the most valuable enemy within 700 of it
commands.hero_starlight_phase_tooltip: Teleports; a light mine left behind detonates a second later
commands.hero_starlight_lance_tooltip: Charges 2 s, then holds a solar lance on the target; everything else on the line burns too
commands.hero_hive_directive_tooltip: Every drone focuses one enemy, harder; their hits slow it and it is revealed
commands.hero_hive_kamikaze_tooltip: Drones dive onto a point and explode; two are rebuilt at once
commands.hero_hive_mothership_tooltip: Anchors and launches Guardian gunships; drones rebuild 3x faster, the swarm hits harder, a repair field heals
commands.hero_powershot_tooltip: Locks the turret on one target and fires a rapid series of heavy gauss shells; every shell that hits it adds 8% to the next, anything on the line takes half
commands.hero_circlebeam_tooltip: Anchors for 3 s (25% less damage taken) and sweeps a twin laser all around, burning everything it crosses
commands.hero_titangrip_tooltip: Grabs an enemy machine and hurls it into the densest enemy cluster; the landing crushes and stuns. A hero is kicked back instead
commands.hero_warcry_tooltip: Rallies the army (damage, speed) and taunts the enemies around onto Colossus, which takes less damage
commands.hero_earthshatter_tooltip: Leaps onto a point, landing in a stunning quake; six fissures erupt three times
commands.hero_furnace_tooltip: Inhales, pulling the enemies around in, then exhales a fire nova
commands.hero_hellonearth_tooltip: Becomes a living inferno: burns everything around, calls meteors, double Heat, and erupts at the end
commands.hero_doompainter_tooltip: Paints a target with a laser: it takes more damage from everything, and the next salvo homes on it
commands.hero_retrorockets_tooltip: Fires the tubes into the ground to leap away; the takeoff spot burns and slows
commands.hero_banisherlock_tooltip: Both racks ripple-fire heavy missiles at one target; +50% against a Shredded one
commands.hero_siegemode_tooltip: Digs in: immobile, tougher, longer range, and the shells leave pools of lava. Cast again to undeploy (toggle)
commands.hero_eruption_tooltip: Lobs volcanic bombs onto an area, each leaving lava, then the ground erupts
commands.hero_printturret_tooltip: Prints a quad laser turret on the spot for a while
commands.hero_repairswarm_tooltip: Sends every drone to repair an ally (or itself) and the allies around it
commands.hero_swarmprotocol_tooltip: Prints waves of kamikaze micro-drones that dive onto an area
commands.hero_mines_tooltip: Scatters hidden EMP mines; an enemy that comes close sets one off
commands.hero_shadowstep_tooltip: Blinks behind an enemy and disintegrates it point-blank; it is Marked and takes more from the Commando
commands.hero_blackout_tooltip: An EMP storm: damage, a long stun, shields drained, and the enemies lose sight of the Commando
commands.hero_reconflare_tooltip: A flare reveals an area (cloaked units too); enemies in it are Exposed and take more damage
commands.hero_tumble_tooltip: A quick evasive hop: the gun reloads at once and the next volley hits harder
commands.hero_killshot_tooltip: Channels 2 s, then fires a rail round that pierces its line; a kill refunds half the cooldown
commands.hero_flakcanopy_tooltip: A flak umbrella shoots down incoming shells, rockets and bombs, and the AA pods hit harder
commands.hero_hydra_tooltip: Grows, speeds up and fires a lock volley every second on top of its own weapons
commands.hero_lancecharge_tooltip: Boosts forward at four times its speed, ramming everything on the path; the next bolt fires at once and harder
commands.hero_phasedecoy_tooltip: Leaves a hologram that taunts the enemies and explodes; the Cataphract cloaks and speeds away
commands.hero_gauntlet_tooltip: Chains lance dashes through the most valuable enemies around, untargetable meanwhile
commands.hero_saturation_tooltip: Paints an area (a 2.5 s warning everyone sees), then rockets rain on it for 5 s and Lock what they hit
commands.hero_coronaflare_tooltip: A solar burst around Helios: burns and heats the enemies, repairs the allies
commands.hero_sunspot_tooltip: A miniature sun hovers over the point and lashes the enemies under it with heat rays; ignitions under it make it last longer
commands.hero_gravitylens_tooltip: A gravity well for 6 s pulls the enemies to its centre; the cannon reloads at once and its shells landing inside hit harder
commands.hero_skyeye_tooltip: An orbital eye reveals an area (sight, radar, cloaked units); the enemies under it are Observed and take more damage from everyone
commands.hero_starfall_tooltip: Meteors rain on an area for 8 s, each leaving a Star; a final Comet hits the centre
commands.hero_huntmark_tooltip: Marks the prey: revealed, the rails focus it, Longinus deals more damage to it; a marked kill resets the cooldown and heals
commands.hero_phaserail_tooltip: Rail-phases to the point in 0.4 s, untouchable and through units; the enemies on the path are hit and Sundered; the rails reload on arrival
commands.hero_stormcharge_tooltip: Dashes in a lightning charge: the enemies on the path are hit and stunned, a thunderclap on arrival; the next shot is a Breach Shot
commands.hero_echoes_tooltip: Storm images of Tempest fight beside it; they fire Breach Shots with it and explode when they fade
commands.hero_eyestorm_tooltip: Tempest becomes a spinning storm: lightning lashes everything around, it takes half damage, cannot be stunned and reflects damage; it ends with a thunderclap
commands.hero_dive_tooltip: Drones dive onto the target like missiles and detonate; for 10 s the drones rebuild 3x faster
commands.hero_hive_tooltip: She roots and becomes a living hive: tougher, faster and longer-ranged cannons, a stream of swarm-mites, drones rebuilt fast. Cast again to end it (toggle)
commands.hero_deathgrip_tooltip: A chain hook drags the target in front of Keres and stuns it; the riot cannon fires point-blank
commands.hero_souldevour_tooltip: Devours a broken non-hero enemy whole (no wreck): Keres heals a multiple of the HP it had left plus 10% of its max, and gains 5 Souls
commands.hero_macabre_tooltip: Keres lets its Souls loose as hunting spirits that strike different enemies every second; it gains lifesteal
commands.hero_burrow_tooltip: Dives underground (untargetable, unseen, cannot fire) and travels fast to the point, then erupts: damage and stun around
commands.hero_coil_tooltip: Lunges onto a big target and coils around it: it is crushed (a share of its max HP per second) and stunned; Mukade takes less damage and keeps firing
commands.hero_waterspout_tooltip: A waterspout erupts at the point: enemies are tossed up and stunned; a mist stays 5 s and drowns them in Undertow (bigger over water)
commands.hero_surge_tooltip: Rides a wave to the point: enemies on the path are knocked aside, hit and slowed; the wake slows. Further and twice as often over water
commands.hero_maw_tooltip: A maelstrom pulls enemies to its maw for 7 s; the core swallows small units whole; it ends with a tidal blast
commands.hero_locusts_tooltip: Micro-rockets in three waves, each homing on a different enemy around the point; spare ones burn the ground
commands.hero_lockdown_tooltip: Anchors itself: immobile, armoured, longer weapon range, faster rocket racks, gatlings spun up. Cast again to end it (toggle)
commands.hero_plague_tooltip: Locks in place and rains locust rockets on an area for 10 s; every impact leaves fire
commands.hero_gaze_tooltip: Her gaze sweeps a cone: every enemy in it gains Petrify stacks; enemies already stone shatter
commands.hero_snakepit_tooltip: A nest of serpents circles the point and bites every enemy in it (once a second each), adding Petrify
commands.hero_stonegarden_tooltip: After 1.5 s everything in the area turns to stone (structures too) and takes more damage; when the stone ends every statue shatters
commands.hero_ambassador_long_tooltip: Toggle: long-range rockets - much longer range, 15% less damage
commands.hero_ambassador_cluster_tooltip: Toggle: cluster warheads - less direct damage, every rocket scatters bomblets over an area
commands.hero_ambassador_nuke_tooltip: Toggle: tactical nuclear warheads - very slow reload, heavy hits, every salvo opens with a nuclear blast
commands.hero_negotiator_long_tooltip: Toggle: long-range rockets - much longer range, 15% less damage
commands.hero_negotiator_cluster_tooltip: Toggle: cluster warheads - less direct damage, every rocket scatters bomblets over an area
commands.hero_negotiator_nuke_tooltip: Toggle: tactical nuclear warheads - very slow reload, heavy hits, every salvo opens with a nuclear blast
commands.hero_boreas_long_tooltip: Toggle: long-range rockets - much longer range, 15% less damage
commands.hero_boreas_cluster_tooltip: Toggle: cluster warheads - less direct damage, every rocket scatters bomblets over an area
commands.hero_boreas_nuke_tooltip: Toggle: tactical nuclear warheads - very slow reload, heavy hits, every salvo opens with a nuclear blast

massSelect.sameType: Select all units of same type as selected
massSelect.sameTypeVisible: Select same type as current, on screen

queues.prepend: Add order to start of order queue

controlGroups.focus: Select control group %{n} and focus camera
controlGroups.removeOne: Remove closest unit from its group

camera.cycleSelectedNext: Cycle camera to next selected unit
camera.cycleSelectedPrev: Cycle camera to previous selected unit

keybindProfiles.activateDescription: Loads this keybind profile, replacing every key you have bound.
